senses.gloss: pr. n. m. (b. h.) Lot, the nephew of Abraham.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 54a:14">Ber. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>הרואה … אשתו של ל׳</he> he who sees … Lot’s wife (the pillar of salt, <cite ref="Genesis 19:26">Gen. XIX, 26</cite>).
<cite ref="Eruvin 65a:4">Erub. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>הגיע לשכרותו של ל׳</he> who is as drunk (unconscious) as Lot.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:11">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> (play on the name) <he>לוט לוטא וכ׳</he> cursed Lot shall not be Abram’s heir; a. fr.
